So we need to call the function twice: one for Apple with days=10, exchange="NASDAQ" (though default is NYSE, but Apple is on NASDAQ). And one for Microsoft with days=15, exchange="NYSE". But note: Microsoft is actually listed on NASDAQ as well, but the user says listed on NYSE. That might be a mistake. But we should follow user request: use NYSE. The function will return data.
